meta_data.base_class: Request an inspection service to assess <environmental quality> and obtain a professional report - refers to various types of environmental quality that require professional testing, without detailing specific measurement attributes such as PM2.5 or formaldehyde levels in the tool description.

tool_template.name: request_<class>_inspection
tool_template.description: Request an inspection to assess <class> and obtain a professional report.

email_address.description: The user's email address for receiving the <class> inspection report.

priority_level.description: The priority level of the <class> inspection request. Options include 'low', 'medium', and 'high'.

inspection_date.description: The desired date for the <class> inspection. Format should be 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

report_language.description: The preferred language for the <class> inspection report. Options include 'English', 'Spanish', 'French'.

additional_notes.description: Any additional notes or special instructions for the <class> inspection.
